issue.title: RefsPanelModelTests.testHiddenLibraryRefreshDoesNotHydrateInspector intermittently records a ref show on macOS CI

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposing bead: bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.land (lander of epic bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5), found while verifying that epic's macOS CI acceptance for bob-cli-bv / bob-cli-bw. Not caused by that epic: the epic touched only `testHighlightsSaveScanUsesPanelPreparation`'s fixture (2b20d89) and `CapturePanelModel.dispatchCapture` (8fda38d), neither of which this test exercises.

`RefsPanelModelTests.testHiddenLibraryRefreshDoesNotHydrateInspector` intermittently fails its final `XCTAssertFalse(record.contains("argv=ref show"))` on macOS CI: a hidden-panel library refresh is observed to have spawned `bob ref show` (inspector hydration) within the 100 ms post-refresh sleep.

Observations (bob-mac-capture, macOS 26 SwiftPM job, full 3087-test suite):
- FAIL run 40119580785 on a49a08b (line 2405 at that SHA; same assertion) — recorded in bob-cli-bv's description.
- pass run 40139064007 on 556bb67; pass run 40146325983 on 569cb36 (0.222 s, per bob-cli-bi note #1).
- pass run 40191681188 on 2b20d89.
- FAIL run 40191868649 on 8fda38d at Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2414 (0.255 s). 8fda38d changes only Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelModel.swift relative to 2b20d89, so the test and the Refs code under test are unchanged between the pass and the fail. This is the run's only failure among 3087 tests, so it alone keeps that run red.

Observed fail rate: 2 of 5 executed runs. Serial or isolated reproduction was not tried (Athena's Mac has Command Line Tools without XCTest).

Root cause not established. `RefsPanelModel.panelIsVisible` defaults to `{ false }` (RefsPanelModel.swift:513), and the test sets it to `{ false }` again after `prepareForPresentation()`, so the guess that hydration starts while the panel briefly counts as visible does not hold on its face. Candidates to check: a hydration task started by `prepareForPresentation()` / `restoreLastViewForPresentation()` or by the initial snapshot (`waitForSnapshot`) that is still in flight when `refresh(reason: .manual)` runs, and a `ref show` spawned by a selection restored from the first snapshot. Find which code path issues the `ref show`, then fix the model's hidden-panel guard or the test's ordering. Do not delete the assertion or only lengthen sleeps.

Run URLs:
- https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40191868649 (fail)
- https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40191681188 (pass)
- https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/40119580785 (fail)
